      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled P2P and modifies peer socket event handling in src/net.cpp and P2P functional tests.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents event loop busy-spinning and stalls caused by unconsumed TCP urgent data triggering select() exceptions on established connections. Per the description, 'select() can busy-spin continuously without progressing', which exposes node networking to denial-of-service and connection liveness issues."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies HTTP server socket handling in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures HTTP server connections disconnect promptly on POLLERR/POLLHUP when reading is paused by backpressure rather than attempting doomed sends. The change improves HTTP socket error handling consistency but is secondary to the main P2P networking fix."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Functional test updates and additions to netutil.py specifically support testing P2P socket error behavior rather than general test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests that exercise and pin the behavior of a specific area belong to that area rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies the shared Sock abstraction in src/util/sock.h and src/util/sock.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Introduces ConnErrorEventFlag to Sock::Wait() so callers opt into exception monitoring only during non-blocking connect attempts. This resolves unexpected wakeups on select() across consumers of the Sock primitive."
    }
